settings.label: SWE-bench Bash-only
settings.summary: Real-world GitHub issue resolution with every model using the same minimal bash-only agent scaffold.
settings.description: Models receive a real GitHub issue and repository and must produce a patch that passes the issue-specific and regression tests. This Bash-only view holds the agent loop fixed to mini-SWE-agent with a minimal bash interface, making it primarily a comparison of language models under the same scaffold.
settings.task_population: 500 issues in the pinned bash-only snapshot
settings.resampling_unit: Pooled task rows; outcomes for all models on a task are resampled jointly
limitations: The pooled task-row target treats benchmark issues as independent rows; repository dependence can change the uncertainty target.
The analysis quantifies finite-task ranking uncertainty and does not establish construct validity or deployment representativeness.
settings.tie_rule: Models with equal observed scores are kept together; bootstrap ties split rank mass equally across occupied ranks (absolute tolerance 1e-12).
settings.tier_rule: Observed-order maximal common intersection of central RPM rank-mass intervals.

settings.label: AlpacaEval 2 · raw weighted
settings.summary: Automatic pairwise preference judgments of instruction-following responses against a GPT-4 Turbo reference.
settings.description: AlpacaEval 2 asks an automatic evaluator to compare each model response with a GPT-4 Turbo reference response on the same instruction. This report analyzes the raw weighted preference rate, not AlpacaEval's official length-controlled headline, so response-length and judge biases remain important caveats.
settings.resampling_unit: Pooled task rows; outcomes for all models on a task are resampled jointly
limitations: The analyzed raw weighted preference is length-sensitive and is not the official length-controlled headline metric.
Scores inherit evaluator bias from an LLM judge.
settings.tie_rule: Models with equal observed scores are kept together; bootstrap ties split rank mass equally across occupied ranks (absolute tolerance 1e-12).
settings.tier_rule: Observed-order maximal common intersection of central RPM rank-mass intervals.

settings.label: WildBench v2
settings.summary: Checklist-guided evaluation of chat assistants on challenging conversations from real users.
settings.description: WildBench v2 collects difficult, open-ended user conversations and builds a task-specific checklist of evaluation criteria for each one. An LLM judge scores responses against those checklists; this report uses the common-task intersection in the pinned release.
settings.resampling_unit: Pooled task rows; outcomes for all models on a task are resampled jointly
limitations: Scores inherit evaluator bias from gpt-4o-2024-05-13.
The common-task intersection is conditional on the pinned release and included model pool.
settings.tie_rule: Models with equal observed scores are kept together; bootstrap ties split rank mass equally across occupied ranks (absolute tolerance 1e-12).
settings.tier_rule: Observed-order maximal common intersection of central RPM rank-mass intervals.

settings.label: LiveBench · pooled
settings.summary: A pooled view of the coding, language, and instruction-following tasks shared by 81 models.
settings.description: LiveBench uses regularly refreshed questions and automatically verifiable ground-truth answers to limit contamination and avoid an LLM judge. This report's pooled view combines only the coding, language, and instruction-following tasks in its pinned complete model-by-task rectangle; it is not LiveBench's overall global score.
settings.task_population: 318 tasks across coding, language, and instruction following
settings.resampling_unit: Pooled task rows; outcomes for all models on a task are resampled jointly
limitations: LiveBench is dynamic; this report applies only to the pinned revision and selected complete model-task rectangle.
The pooled task-row bootstrap does not repair benchmark population or topical-clustering limitations.
settings.tie_rule: Models with equal observed scores are kept together; bootstrap ties split rank mass equally across occupied ranks (absolute tolerance 1e-12).
settings.tier_rule: Observed-order maximal common intersection of central RPM rank-mass intervals.
